title: 2012 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: What is the units digit of \(13^{2012}?\)

solutions.text:
We have to find \(13^{2012} \mod 10.\) The following is true:

\[\begin{align*}13^{2012} &\equiv 3^{2012} \mod 10\\&\equiv 81^{503} \mod 10\\&\equiv 1^{503} \mod 10\\&\equiv 1 \mod 10\end{align*}\]

This means \(13^{2012}\) has the same units digit as \(1,\) so the units digit of \(13^{2012} \) is \(1.\)

Thus, the answer is A .
hints: Only the units digit of the base matters.
Powers of \(3\) have a units-digit cycle of length \(4\).
